tools.name: count_jobs
tools.description:
Count how many jobs match a search without returning full results. Returns structured JSON.

Use this when the user asks "how many jobs..." (in any language), including
salary-constrained counts like "how many jobs pay at least 60k?" or
"how many jobs advertise a salary at all?" (use has_salary=True
